name: Mia
source:
The other half of the evil twins, together Mia and [url=/c106071]Naomi[/url] terrorize the girls at their new school with their brazen confidence and genius deviance.

If you catch the eye of the twins, get ready to suffer the consequences.

Using all means at their disposal to get what they want, and with no morals, the twins are the most dangerous duo in the whole school.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Mia]DumbKoala[/url]]
